title: What Will Artem Eat? One Button, No More Dead Ends | vitalii.no
description:
Until now, tapping the NovoRapid dose button only worked well if Artem's parents had already walked through a separate step to pick his food first. Hit it cold and the dose dialog had no carbs to work with — and if blood sugar hadn't been checked in the last 30 minutes, the app just showed a dead-end warning with no way to act on it.

The food-picker dialog now accepts a plan flag. Pressing the dose button with no recent plate switches it into plan mode: the title becomes "What will Artem eat?", the eat-now button hides, and a new "no food" button sits alongside the normal choice. Picking food runs the dose calculation against the chosen carbs, blood-glucose-based correction, and active insulin. If no blood sugar reading exists within 30 minutes, a "Measure now" button now appears inline instead of a dead end.

Every path through the button now ends in a working dose screen instead of a warning — food or no food, measured or not, it is always just one tap away from a number his parents can act on.
